business_summary: Kingsignal Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of signal interconnected products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers RF cables, such as semi-rigid and flexible, military standard RG series, corrugated coaxial, KSR and FLL low loss, micro coaxial, MS2 low loss, tri-coaxial, CATV coaxial, test, multiple core coaxial, and stable cables, as well as commercial wires; and RF connectors. It also provides power transmission products, including circular electrical connector, micro rectangular electrical connector, and power cable; and optical passive connector, optical transceivers, optical cable assembly, and optical transceivers assembly, as well as outdoor communication optical, central beam tube type optical, GYDXTW, power, adss, butterfly optical, special type optical, indoor communication optical, and optical fiber cables. In addition, the company offers external and internal high-speed cable, transceiver, MPO jumper, external and active optical cable, and high current cable and connector; circuit board; and Kingsignal Wi-Fi mesh, KS-TWS wireless Bluetooth headset, and docking station. Further, it provides deep coverage solutions comprising 4G/5G access network, indoor coverage, and satellite access solutions; rail transit, new energy vehicle, industrial automation, and medical wiring harness solutions; and intelligent IoT and EMC solutions. Kingsignal Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: Kingsignal Technology Co., Ltd.는 중화인민공화국 및 해외에서 상호 연결된 신호 제품의 연구 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 반강성 및 유연성, 군용 표준 RG 시리즈, 주름형 동축, KSR 및 FLL 저손실, 마이크로 동축, MS2 저손실, 3중 동축, CATV 동축, 테스트, 다중 코어 동축 및 안정적인 케이블과 같은 RF 케이블과 상업용 전선을 제공합니다. 및 RF 커넥터. 또한 원형 전기 커넥터, 마이크로 직사각형 전기 커넥터 및 전원 케이블을 포함한 전력 전송 제품을 제공합니다. 광수동커넥터, 광트랜시버, 광케이블 조립체, 광트랜시버 조립체, 실외통신광, 중앙빔관형광, GYDXTW, 파워, 광고, 버터플라이광, 특수형광, 실내통신광, 광섬유케이블 등을 포함한다. 또한 회사는 외부 및 내부 고속 케이블, 트랜시버, MPO 점퍼, 외부 및 활성 광케이블, 고전류 케이블 및 커넥터를 제공합니다. 회로 기판; Kingsignal Wi-Fi 메시, KS-TWS 무선 Bluetooth 헤드셋 및 도킹 스테이션. 게다가 프로다.
